summary: RollerCoaster Tycoon entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: RollerCoaster Tycoon 3
entries.definitive_edition: RollerCoaster Tycoon 3: Complete Edition on Windows PC

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC Complete Edition with expansion content and widescreen support

primary.why: Complete Edition is the current PC route and includes both Soaked! and Wild! expansions, widescreen support, 1080p, and compatibility work for modern hardware. Original Platinum/Deluxe and mobile/console ports are secondary comparison routes.
primary.how_to_play: Use Complete Edition on PC. Record storefront/build, resolution/aspect, graphics settings, expansion scenarios, custom content, sandbox/campaign progress, coaster cam use, and whether Switch/console/mobile versions were compared.

secondary.why: Complete Edition is the modern complete route.
PC is the best capture and construction/editing route.

all_releases.reason: secondary: baseline before expansion/Complete Edition state.

all_releases.fidelity: Expansion content needed for full official coverage.

all_releases.platform: Complete Edition on PC / Switch / modern consoles
all_releases.fidelity: Modern package with Soaked!, Wild!, widescreen, 1080p, and compatibility updates.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Complete Edition is both the current fidelity and completeness route for official content.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record publisher/build and custom content; older Platinum/Deluxe packages are not identical storefront artifacts.

entries.title: RollerCoaster Tycoon 2
entries.definitive_edition: Triple Thrill Pack assets with OpenRCT2 version or original executable explicitly recorded

emulation.notes: Use OpenRCT2 for modern stability; original executable for exact-version study.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original executable or OpenRCT2 with exact version/assets documented

primary.version: Triple Thrill Pack assets through OpenRCT2 where appropriate
primary.why: The GOG/Steam Triple Thrill Pack provides the base game and both expansions, while OpenRCT2 is the practical modern engine route that still requires original game files. Exact original behavior should be labeled separately from OpenRCT2 improvements.
primary.how_to_play: Use GOG/Steam RCT2 Triple Thrill Pack assets, optionally through OpenRCT2. Record source, OpenRCT2 version or original executable, expansion content, scenario, park/save, cheats, object packs, resolution, and whether RCT Classic was compared.

secondary.why: OpenRCT2 changes limits/UI/fixes and must be labeled.
It is not the original RCT2 executable route.

all_releases.fidelity: Base game plus Wacky Worlds and Time Twister expansions.
Modern open-source engine requiring original RCT2 files.
all_releases.reason: primary: practical modern route with caveats.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: OpenRCT2 is the practical route but changes behavior/UI/limits; original executable is needed for exact 2002 behavior.

entries.remaster_caveats: OpenRCT2 requires original files and is not the original executable; RCT Classic is a separate repackage.
